about_the_game:
Create the ultimate beachfront destination!

A game all about building a beautiful boardwalk.  In the demo for Boardwalk Builders, start with nothing and build a small boardwalk featuring an introduction to the many shops offered in the full game.  Combine those shops together to create higher level shops that earn more money and handle more customers. 

Build your boardwalk

  • With each customer visit, earn experience towards leveling up your boardwalk and earning rewards

  • Unlock seven stands to build as your boardwalk increases in level

  • Build shops for all kinds of products and a strength-testing attraction

Manage your boardwalk to optimize your income

  • Upgrade your shops to increase their revenue and how quickly they serve customers

  • Launch marketing campaigns to bring in more customers to earn more money and increase demand

Combine shops and attractions to create new ones

  • Once you've got a healthy crowd of visitors, combine your shops together to create bigger shops that charge higher prices and serve more customers at a time

  • Combine the seven base stands together to create seven additional larger shops

Other Features:

  • Respond to demand-changing events such as bad weather or neighboring competition

  • Earn rewards as your boardwalk levels up from customer visits, reaching up to level 25

What is available in the full game?

  • Dozens of shops to build and dozens more shop combinations

  • An expanded set of boardwalk level rewards, including hiring entertainers, charging prices for boardwalk admission, and more

  • A higher boardwalk level cap

  • Participate in themed boardwalk events to highlight certain shops and bring them a wealth of visitors

  • Navigate dealing with local competition and take advantage of unplanned opportunities

  • Earn visits from VIPs to unlock special buildings and earn unique boardwalk rewards

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Design and grow your boardwalk by building attractions, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds. Manage and combine your attractions to create even grander experiences. Launch marketing campaigns to spread the word about your boardwalk and draw in crowds.
